sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The attack mechanic is where things get interesting - players can push their opponent off the screen or land on top of them to eliminate them.

One of the standout features of Neon King is its tight controls. The game's physics engine is well-implemented, making it feel responsive and precise.
